tip_title: The Endorsement on Your Home Policy Might Not Be Enough for Your Business
topic: Home-Based Business Insurance - Standalone Policy vs. Endorsement
blurb:
💡 **Insurance Tip: The Endorsement on Your Home Policy Might Not Be Enough for Your Business**

A few weeks back we talked about the business equipment and liability gap in standard homeowners policies, and how an endorsement can help patch it. But here's where endorsements hit their ceiling: they typically can't cover lost business income. A dedicated home business policy is a separate, fuller option that extends your personal property and liability coverage to your business AND picks up expenses and lost income for up to a year if a fire, storm, or covered event forces you to shut down temporarily. If your home-based work is your primary income source, that gap is worth knowing about.

Not sure whether an endorsement is enough or whether a separate policy makes more sense for your situation? Your Peachy agent can walk through the options with you.

📖 [Learn more from the Insurance Information Institute](https://www.iii.org/article/insuring-your-home-business)
summary: Covers dedicated home business insurance as a step beyond the homeowners endorsement, specifically the business interruption and lost income coverage that endorsements typically don't provide — distinct from the prior tip's focus on the equipment sub-limit gap and endorsement as the fix.
